quote.en:
May the first ray of morning bring new hope to your life.

Start your day with a grateful heart.

Every morning is a new opportunity; accept it with joy.

Make the most of every new sunrise.

Start your day with a smile and positive vibes.

A smile is the best way to start your day.

May your today be even better than yesterday.

Focus on progress, not perfection.

New morning, new energy, new beginning.

Every day is a fresh start.

Success comes to those who wake up with a purpose.

Rise and shine for your goals.

A beautiful start to a beautiful morning.

Enjoy the peace of the early hours.

May God's grace stay with you throughout the day.

Blessed and highly favored.

May happiness find you today, Good Morning.

Wishing you a joyful morning.

Something wonderful is going to happen today.

Stay expectant and positive.

A happy mind leads to a happy life.

Your thoughts color your world.

A day full of freshness is waiting for you.

Embrace the energy of the morning.

Every day is a gift; unwrap it with joy.

Gratitude turns what we have into enough.

Wake up with positive thoughts and big dreams.

Dream big, work hard.

May the sunlight brighten your path today.

Walk in the light of positivity.

Morning peace leads to all-day happiness.

Protect your peace early.

Today is another step toward your dreams.

Don't stop until you're proud.

Good thoughts lead to a great day.

Think good, do good.

Let's learn something new and exciting today.

Growth is a daily choice.

May your smile be the light for someone else today.

Spread kindness like confetti.

Forget the day's fatigue and sleep peacefully.

Rest is the best meditation.

May the stars guard your sleep tonight.

Sleep under the protection of the universe.

A brand new morning is waiting for you tomorrow.

Rest now, for tomorrow is yours.

Fall asleep with sweet dreams and a calm heart.

Let go of today's worries.

May the coolness of the moon bring peace to your mind.

The night is for healing.

Forgive yourself for today's mistakes and sleep well.

Tomorrow is a new page.

Find solace in the silence of the night.

Silence is the language of the soul.

May God grant you protection and deep peace.

Rest in His grace.

Time to get lost in the beautiful world of dreams.

Dreaming is the first step to doing.

Good night, let's meet tomorrow with new energy.

Recharge your spirit tonight.

When sleep comes, let all your sorrows rest.

Give your heart a break.

Darkness will pass; the light will surely return.

Hope remains even in the dark.

Forgive everyone before you close your eyes.

Sleep with a clean heart.

Take rest, for you must conquer again tomorrow.

Preparation starts with rest.

May your pillow be as soft as the clouds.

Comfortable rest for a busy mind.

The night is deep, but hope shines brighter.

Stars can't shine without darkness.

Peaceful sleep is the greatest wealth you can own.

Value your rest.

May the starry night bring tranquility to your soul.

Nature's lullaby.

In the embrace of sleep, you are safe and sound.

Rest easy.

Tomorrow's sun will bring fresh joys and laughter.

A beautiful day awaits.

You are the most beautiful part of my life.

My heart belongs to you.

A heart drowned in love remembers only you.

You are my favorite thought.

My whole world is reflected in your eyes.

Looking at you is my home.

Love isn't what is shown, but what is kept in the heart.

True love is silent but deep.

My every day begins and ends with your memories.

You are my dawn and dusk.

If you are with me, every destination is easy to reach.

Together we can conquer anything.

Love is a form of worship and devotion.

I adore you more each day.

Your one smile has the power to make my day.

Happiness is seeing you happy.

The meeting of two souls is what true love is.

Destiny brought us together.

Are you reality or a beautiful dream come true?

I never want to wake up from us.

My heart beats only for you and your happiness.

You are my rhythm.

True love is eternal and never ends.

Forever is just a start.

You are my first, my last, and my everything.

My heart is yours.

Bowing in love is not a weakness, it's a strength.

Sacrifice is the language of love.

Life is incomplete and empty without you.

You complete me.

Love is the greatest strength in the universe.

Nothing is more powerful than us.

My heartbeat belongs to you, and my memories too.

You are part of my soul.

A journey that starts and ends with you.

The only path I want to take.

Love has no religion, it only knows the heart.

Universal language of the soul.

Just stay with me, and we will win the world.

Us against the world.

Real peace is found only at the feet of the Divine.

Surrender and find your soul.

Whatever happens is according to His divine will.

Trust the process of God.

There is immense strength in true devotion.

Faith moves mountains.

Chant His name, and your worries will vanish.

His name is the ultimate medicine.

Faith and patience are the pillars of a spiritual life.

Wait on the Lord.

God resides in every atom and every soul.

You are never alone.

You are the doer, and You are the creator.

All glory to the Almighty.

Never leave His side, even in the darkest times.

He is your light.

Work is worship when done with a pure heart.

Labor for the Lord.

The Divine is the only ultimate truth.

Seek the eternal.

Chanting His name brings peace to the restless mind.

Calm in the storm.

Unbreakable faith is the essence of true bhakti.

Hold on to your belief.

All fears vanish in the shelter of the Lord.

He is your fortress.

Morning prayer is the purification of the soul.

Start with the Divine.

Whatever God does, He does for our highest good.

Trust His plan.

Look within your heart, for God dwells there.

The kingdom of God is within.

Faith is the foundation of a meaningful life.

Believe to see.

Without the Divine, everything is empty and hollow.

Soul's true home.

Devotion is the thread that connects us to God.

Stay connected.

God's grace is boundless and infinite.

Blessings upon blessings.

You haven't lost until you stop trying.

Persistence is the key.

Success belongs to those who believe in their dreams.

Dream it, do it.

Difficulties only come to those who can handle them.

You are stronger than you think.

Today's hard work is the foundation of tomorrow's peace.

Plant now, harvest later.

Believe in yourself, and the world will be at your feet.

Confidence is silent.

There are no shortcuts to any place worth going.

Value the journey.

Those who keep trying never truly fail.

Failure is a lesson, not an end.

Times change, just keep working hard and stay patient.

Your time is coming.

Think big, act big, and become big.

Ambition is the engine.

Your struggle is the story of your success.

Wear your scars with pride.

Accept challenges as opportunities for growth.

Grow through what you go through.

You must be obsessed to reach your goals.

Passion fuels purpose.

Don't fear the dark; that's where the stars shine brightest.

Light is coming.

Every small change is a part of a massive success.

Small wins matter.

Don't stop when you're tired; stop when you're done.

Endurance wins.

Your work will eventually speak for itself.

Let results be your noise.

Write your own destiny with your own hands.

You are the architect.

Courage is the greatest weapon in your arsenal.

Be brave.

Don't lose your today by worrying about tomorrow.

Be present.

Victory is certain if your resolve is unshakable.

Mindset is everything.

The glow of festivals and the warmth of loved ones.

Celebrate the bonds.

May this festival fill your life with eternal joy.

Wishes for a bright life.

A festival of sweetness, light, and laughter.

Spread the cheer.

Today brings a beautiful gift of happiness.

Cherish the moments.

Celebrating the victory of good over evil.

Light always wins.

A confluence of vibrant colors and high spirits.

Live life in color.

Festivals are the threads that bring us together.

Unity in celebration.

May every home light a lamp and every heart be glad.

Brighten the world.

Respecting traditions, celebrating happiness.

Honoring our roots.

May this festival bring sweetness to all your relations.

Love in every bite.

New seasons, new festivals, new hopes.

Always something to celebrate.

Celebrate every festival with great enthusiasm.

Live out loud.

Congratulations on this shower of festive happiness.

Blessings to you.

A festival that teaches us love and peace.

Soulful celebrations.

May all your wishes come true on this auspicious day.

Manifest your joy.

Decorate your home, for the festival is finally here.

Welcome the vibes.

Our festivals are symbols of our beautiful unity.

Stronger together.

Share the happiness, celebrate the season.

Giving is receiving.

Hearty greetings for this wonderful festival.

Best wishes always.

May prosperity and peace grow in your life.

Abundance for all.

Family is the greatest strength in the world.

My rock.

Home is where the heart finds its rest.

Safe haven.

Parents' blessings are the truest form of wealth.

Rich in love.

Staying together is the identity of a great family.

Unity is power.

Life is incomplete and empty without family.

Everything starts here.

A happy family makes for a beautiful life.

Blessed home.

Respect for elders and love for the young ones.

The circle of life.

Only family stands by you in times of crisis.

Unconditional support.

Learn to value the bonds that never break.

Priceless relations.

The foundation of values begins within the family.

Rooted in goodness.

My family is my life and my soul.

Love without limits.

Supporting each other is the soul of a family.

Lift each other up.

To the world you are one person, to your family you are the world.

You matter.

The peace of a home lies in a mother's smile.

Angel in the house.

Walking while holding a father's hand is true security.

Guide and protector.

Sibling love is an unbreakable and eternal bond.

Friends for life.

Spending time with family is like a piece of heaven.

Quality time.

Let arguments be small and love be big.

Prioritize peace.

Time spent with family is never wasted.

Creating memories.

True happiness is always found at home.

Heart's destination.

The movie isn't over yet, my friend!

Stay for the climax.

Life is a movie; just play your role perfectly.

Own your story.

A hero isn't the one who wins, but the one who wins hearts.

Legacy over victory.

Dialogues are just words; the soul is in the acting.

Emotions are real.

What appears on screen is the fruit of hard work.

Respect the craft.

Cinema is a beautiful world of dreams.

Escape to reality.

Every common man is the hero of his own story.

You are the lead.

A twist in the story is what makes it interesting.

Embrace the changes.

Emotions matter much more than action.

Feel the scene.

The sound of applause is the greatest award.

For the fans.

Cinema is the mirror reflecting our society.

Truth on screen.

A good film has the power to change a life.

Inspired by art.

A superstar is one who stays grounded to the roots.

Humility is star power.

The magical and mesmerizing world of cinema.

Pure magic.

Art has no end and no boundaries.

Infinite creativity.

Cinema teaches us how to truly live.

Life in frames.

Every shot tells a new and different story.

Visual storytelling.

Background music is what makes the moment iconic.

The rhythm of life.

Salute to the hard work behind the scenes.

Unsung heroes.

The shine of the screen, the salt of the sweat.

Hard earned glory.

The sacrifice of our heroes will never be in vain.

Honoring the fallen.

My country is my religion and my pride.

Patriotism first.

Heroes never die; they become immortal in our hearts.

Eternal glory.

The flag is my pride and my identity.

Salute to the tricolor.

Freedom was bought with the blood of our heroes.

Never forget.

Dying for the motherland is the ultimate honor.

Sacrifice for the many.

Indomitable courage is the mark of a hero.

Brave souls.

Hail the soldier, hail the farmer.

Backbone of the nation.

Bravery never bows down; history is the witness.

Strength of character.

The protectors of the nation are the real superstars.

True idols.

Sacrifice for a cause never goes unrewarded.

Noble deeds.

Victory to the Motherland!

Long live the nation.

Discipline and bravery are the mantras of life.

Living by the code.

Let your roar be so fierce that the enemy trembles.

Warrior spirit.

Freedom is my birthright and my responsibility.

Protect the liberty.

The nation always comes first.

Duty over self.

In unity lies our greatest strength.

One nation.

There is no love greater than love for the country.

Devotion to home.

Land of the brave, nation of the free.

Home of heroes.

Salute to those who gave their lives for us.

Respect the brave.

Pain hidden in beautiful words is called poetry.

Ink for the soul.

The pen speaks when the heart is too heavy.

Written emotions.

Poetry is the voice of the unspoken feelings.

Rhythm of the heart.

Poetry is the mirror reflecting the soul's depth.

Deep reflections.

A play of words, a confluence of deep feelings.

Art in stanzas.

A story is hidden behind every single poem.

Read between lines.

The sweetness of a verse, the thirst of the soul.

Poetic healing.

A poet says everything without saying a word.

Silent expressions.

Loneliness poured beautifully onto paper.

Art from solitude.

Weaving dreams into words is the essence of poetry.

Soul's embroidery.

Simplicity is the greatest form of poetic beauty.

Minimalist art.

Incomplete stories often make the best poems.

Beauty in fragments.

Words are both the ointment and the wound.

Powerful ink.

The power of the pen is mightier than any sword.

Write the change.

Poetry is not just a hobby; it is a sanctuary.

Find your peace.

Feelings of the heart, witnessed by the paper.

Documenting the soul.

Poetry is a ray of light in the dark night.

Guiding verses.

Two lines, a thousand different meanings.

Depth in brevity.

A poetic style, a secret to understanding life.

Living in verse.

To write is to truly live.

Life on paper.

Friendship is that which exists beyond words.

Soul connection.

A true friend is better than a thousand relatives.

Chosen family.

In friendship, there is no big or small.

Equal hearts.

Walking together is the definition of friendship.

Side by side.

The bond of friendship is the most sacred of all.

Holy union.

Friendship is my faith and my anchor.

Loyalty first.

A friend is one who helps you in your darkest hour.

Light in the dark.

Understanding the heart without a single word.

Quiet understanding.

Having one true friend is better than a thousand acquaintances.

Quality over quantity.

Status has no place in a true friendship.

Heart to heart.

Old memories and true friends stay with you forever.

Timeless bonds.

He is not just a friend; he is my brother.

Family by choice.

Friendship has no expiry date; it is eternal.

Always and forever.

Laughter, fun, and a lifetime of memories.

Good times.

Friendship makes this life worth living.

Life's color.

Relationships should be of the heart, not of blood.

Soul siblings.

True friendship never truly ends.

Distance means nothing.

Every journey is an adventure with a friend.

Better together.

Lucky are those who possess true friends.

Rich in spirit.

Friendship is a gift that not everyone receives.

Cherish the bond.

Many many happy returns of the day!

Celebrate your existence.

May this year be full of happiness and success.

Best year yet.

May success kiss your feet today and always.

Rise to the top.

May you live a thousand years of joy.

Long and happy life.

Get the gift of pure happiness on your birthday.

Blessed day.

Keep smiling always; that's my prayer for you.

Stay radiant.

A party is a must for someone as special as you!

Let's celebrate.

Happy new year and a brand new beginning.

Your personal new year.

May every single wish of yours come true.

Manifesting for you.

Progress a lot and stay happy forever.

Keep growing.

Birthday cake and a whole lot of love.

Sweetest wishes.

May there be a shower of happiness today.

Rain of blessings.

Congratulations on another year of wisdom.

Leveling up.

Laughter, joy, and a mountain of gifts.

Enjoy your day.

Happy Birthday, my dear friend.

Glad you were born.

Age is just a number; keep the passion alive.

Young at heart.

Today is exclusively your day to shine.

Star of the day.

May you receive health, wealth, and peace.

Abundant life.

There is truly no one quite like you.

Unique and special.

Hearty and warmest congratulations on your birthday.

With all my love.

quote.te:
ఈ ఉదయం నీకు కొత్త ఆశ ఇస్తుంది
నిన్నటి బాధలు వదిలిపో
ఈ రోజు నీది
quote.hi:
यह सुबह नई उम्मीद लाती है
कल का दर्द छोड़ दो
आज तुम्हारा है
quote.ta:
இந்த காலை புதிய நம்பிக்கை தரும்
நேற்றை விடு
இன்று உன்னுடையது
quote.kn:
ಈ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಆಶೆ ತರುತ್ತದೆ
ನಿನ್ನೆದನ್ನು ಬಿಡು
ಇಂದು ನಿನ್ನದು
quote.ml:
ഈ പ്രഭാതം പുതിയ പ്രതീക്ഷയാണ്
ഇന്നലെ വിട്ടേക്കൂ
ഇന്ന് നിനക്കുള്ളത്
quote.en:
This morning brings new hope
Let go of yesterday’s pain
Today is yours

quote.te:
సూర్యుడు లేచాడు
నీ కలలూ లేవాలి
ప్రయత్నం మొదలుపెట్టు
quote.hi:
सूरज निकल आया है
तुम भी उठो
सपनों को जगाओ
quote.ta:
சூரியன் உதித்தான்
நீயும் எழு
கனவுகளை தொடங்கு
quote.kn:
ಸೂರ್ಯ ಉದಯವಾಯಿತು
ನೀನು ಎದ್ದು ಬಾ
ಕನಸು ಆರಂಭಿಸು
quote.ml:
സൂര്യൻ ഉദിച്ചു
നീയും എഴുന്നേൽക്കൂ
സ്വപ്നം തുടങ്ങൂ
quote.en:
The sun has risen
Rise with your dreams
Start your effort

quote.te:
ఈ రోజు చిన్న అడుగు వేయి
రేపు అది మార్గం అవుతుంది
quote.hi:
आज छोटा कदम उठाओ
कल वही रास्ता बनेगा
quote.ta:
இன்று சிறு படி போடு
நாளை அது பாதை ஆகும்
quote.kn:
ಇಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಇಡು
ನಾಳೆ ದಾರಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ
quote.ml:
ഇന്ന് ചെറിയ ചുവടുവെക്കൂ
നാളെ അത് വഴി
quote.en:
Take a small step today
Tomorrow it becomes your path

quote.te:
ఉదయం కాంతి నీలో వెలుగు
చిన్న నవ్వుతో మొదలు
రోజు మృదువవుతుంది
quote.hi:
सुबह की रोशनी तुममें है
मुस्कान से शुरू करो
दिन हल्का होगा
quote.ta:
காலை ஒளி உன்னுள் உள்ளது
சிரிப்புடன் தொடங்கு
நாள் மென்மையாகும்
quote.kn:
ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಬೆಳಕು ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಇದೆ
ನಗುವಿನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸು
ದಿನ ಮೃದು ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ
quote.ml:
പ്രഭാതം നിന്റെ ഉള്ളിലെ വെളിച്ചം
പുഞ്ചിരിയോടെ തുടങ്ങൂ
ദിവസം മൃദുവാകും
quote.en:
Morning light lives in you
Begin with a smile
The day softens

quote.te:
నిన్నటి భారాన్ని దించు
ఈ రోజు తేలికగా నడువు
quote.hi:
कल का बोझ उतारो
आज हल्के कदम चलो
quote.ta:
நேற்றின் சுமை விடு
இன்று லேசாக நட
quote.kn:
ನಿನ್ನೆದಿನದ ಭಾರ ಬಿಡು
ಇಂದು ಹಗುರವಾಗಿ ನಡೆ
quote.en:
Drop yesterday’s weight
Walk light today

quote.hi:
चाय की खुशबू में सुकून
मन खुद सध जाता है
quote.en:
In tea’s aroma, there’s calm
The mind finds its place

quote.te:
పక్షుల స్వరం చెబుతుంది
మళ్లీ మొదలు పెట్టు
quote.hi:
पंछी कहते हैं आज
फिर से शुरू करो
quote.en:
Birds are saying today
Begin once again

quote.te:
చిన్న కృతజ్ఞత చెప్పు
రోజు వెలుగుతో నిండుతుంది
quote.hi:
एक धन्यवाद कहो
दिन रोशनी से भर जाएगा
quote.ta:
ஒரு நன்றி சொல்லு
நாள் ஒளியால் நிரையும்
quote.kn:
ಒಂದು ಧನ್ಯವಾದ ಹೇಳು
ದಿನ ಬೆಳಕಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬುತ್ತದೆ
quote.en:
Say a small thank you
The day fills with light

quote.te:
కొత్త పుట తెరవు
నీ కథ మళ్లీ రాయు
quote.hi:
नई पन्ना खोलो
अपनी कहानी फिर लिखो
quote.ta:
புதிய பக்கம் திற
கதையை மீண்டும் எழுது
quote.kn:
ಹೊಸ ಪುಟ ತೆರೆ
ನಿನ್ನ ಕಥೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಬರೆಯು
quote.ml:
പുതിയ പേജ് തുറക്കൂ
കഥ വീണ്ടും എഴുതൂ
quote.en:
Open a new page
Write your story again

quote.hi:
नींद खत्म हुई
हिम्मत शुरू हुई
quote.en:
Sleep has ended
Courage has begun

quote.te:
నీ శ్వాసలో నూతనం ఉంది
దానిని విను
quote.hi:
तेरी सांस में नया है
उसे सुनो
quote.en:
There’s newness in your breath
Listen to it

quote.hi:
थकान छोड़ दो
उम्मीद पकड़ो
quote.en:
Let go of tiredness
Hold on to hope

quote.te:
నెమ్మదిగా మొదలు పెట్టు
స్థిరంగా ముందుకు వెళ్లు
quote.hi:
धीरे शुरू करो
स्थिर आगे बढ़ो
quote.en:
Start slow
Move steady forward

quote.te:
చిన్న విజయం గుర్తు పెట్టు
రోజు చిరునవ్వుతుంది
quote.hi:
छोटी जीत याद करो
दिन मुस्कुराएगा
quote.en:
Remember a small win
The day will smile

quote.te:
నీ అడుగులు చిన్నవైనా
దిశ గొప్పది కావాలి
quote.hi:
कदम छोटे हों
दिशा बड़ी रखो
quote.ta:
அடி சிறியதாக இருந்தாலும்
திசை பெரியதாக இருக்கட்டும்
quote.en:
Even if steps are small
Let direction be big

quote.te:
వెలుగు తలుపు తట్టింది

quote.hi:
रोशनी दस्तक दे रही
दिल से दरवाज़ा खोलो
quote.en:
Light is knocking
Open your heart door

quote.te:
నీ లోపల శక్తి ఉంది
ఈ రోజు దాన్ని చూపు
quote.hi:
तुममें ताकत है
आज उसे दिखाओ
quote.ta:
உன்னுள் சக்தி உள்ளது
இன்று அதை காட்டு
quote.en:
There’s strength in you
Show it today

quote.te:
మంచి ఆలోచనతో లేవు

quote.hi:
अच्छी सोच से उठो
दिन अच्छा होगा
quote.kn:
ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಚಿಂತನೆ ಜೊತೆ ಎದ್ದು
ದಿನ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು
quote.en:
Wake with a good thought
The day turns good

quote.hi:
डर घटता है
जब तुम आगे बढ़ते हो
quote.en:
Fear fades away
When you move forward

quote.te:
నీ గడియారం నడుస్తుంది
నీ కలలూ నడవాలి
quote.hi:
घड़ी चल रही है
सपने भी चलाओ
quote.en:
The clock is ticking
Let dreams move too

quote.te:
తప్పులు పాఠాలు అవుతాయి
ఈ రోజు వాటిని విను
quote.hi:
गलतियाँ सीख बनती हैं
आज उन्हें सुनो
quote.ta:
தவறுகள் பாடம் ஆகும்
இன்று அதை கேள்
quote.en:
Mistakes turn lessons
Listen today

quote.te:
నీ చిరునవ్వు వెలుగు

तुम्हारी मुस्कान रोशनी

quote.ta:
உன் சிரிப்பு ஒளி
வீட்டுக்கு நாள் கொண்டுவரும்
quote.kn:
ನಿನ್ನ ನಗು ಬೆಳಕು
ಮನೆಗೆ ದಿನ ತರುತ್ತದೆ
quote.ml:
നിന്റെ പുഞ്ചിരി വെളിച്ചം
വീട്ടിലേക്ക് ദിവസം കൊണ്ടുവരും
quote.en:
Your smile is light
It carries the day home

quote.te:
ఆలోచనలు స్వచ్ఛంగా ఉంచు
రోజు స్వచ్ఛంగా ఉంటుంది
quote.hi:
सोच साफ रखो
दिन साफ रहेगा
quote.en:
Keep thoughts clean
The day stays clear

quote.te:
ఇది నీ రోజు
దానిని ప్రేమగా జీవించు
quote.hi:
यह तुम्हारा दिन है
इसे प्यार से जियो
quote.ta:
இது உன் நாள்
அதை அன்பாக வாழ்
quote.en:
This is your day
Live it with love

quote.hi:
संदेह घटाओ
कदम बढ़ाओ
quote.kn:
ಸಂದೇಹ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡು
ಕಾಲಿಟ್ಟು ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗು
quote.en:
Reduce doubt
Increase action

quote.te:
నీ కథలో హీరో నీవే
ఈ రోజు సీన్ మొదలు
quote.hi:
कहानी के हीरो तुम
आज का सीन शुरू
quote.ta:
கதையின் ஹீரோ நீ
இன்றைய சீன் தொடங்கு
quote.kn:
ಕಥೆಯ ಹೀರೋ ನೀನು
ಇಂದಿನ ಸೀನ್ ಆರಂಭ
quote.ml:
കഥയിലെ ഹീറോ നീ
ഇന്നത്തെ സീൻ തുടങ്ങി
quote.en:
You’re the hero
Today’s scene begins

quote.te:
మొదటి అడుగు వేసి చూడు
దారి తానే కనిపిస్తుంది
quote.hi:
पहला कदम रखो
रास्ता खुद दिखेगा
quote.ta:
முதல் படி வை
பாதை தானே வரும்
quote.kn:
ಮೊದಲ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಇಡು
ದಾರಿ ತಾನೇ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ
quote.en:
Take the first step
The path will appear

quote.te:
నీ గుండె చెప్పేది విను
అది నిజం చూపుతుంది
quote.hi:
दिल की सुनो
वही सच दिखाता है
quote.kn:
ಹೃದಯದ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳು
ಅದು ಸತ್ಯ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ
quote.en:
Listen to your heart
It shows the truth

quote.te:
నీ రోజు నీ చేతిలోనే

quote.hi:
दिन तुम्हारे हाथ में
इसे संभाल कर चलाओ
quote.ta:
நாள் உன் கையில்
அதை நன்றாக நடத்தி
quote.kn:
ದಿನ ನಿನ್ನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ
ಅದನ್ನು ಜಾಗರೂಕವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಸು
quote.en:
Your day is in your hands
Guide it with care

quote.te:
ఈ రాత్రి నిశ్శబ్దం
నీ మనసు సేదతీరనివ్వు
రేపు కొత్త వెలుగు
quote.hi:
इस रात की शांति में
मन को आराम दो
कल नई रोशनी
quote.ta:
இந்த இரவு அமைதியில்
மனம் ஓய்வெடுக்கட்டும்
நாளை புதிய ஒளி
quote.kn:
ಈ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಶಾಂತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ
ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಕೊಡು
ನಾಳೆ ಹೊಸ ಬೆಳಕು
quote.ml:
ഈ രാത്രിയുടെ ശാന്തിയിൽ
മനസിന് വിശ്രമം
നാളെ പുതിയ വെളിച്ചം
quote.en:
In tonight’s silence
Let your heart rest
Tomorrow brings light

quote.te:
రోజు ముగిసింది
బాధలు వదిలేయ్
నిద్రలో నెమ్మది
quote.hi:
दिन खत्म हुआ
दर्द छोड़ दो
नींद में सुकून
quote.ta:
நாள் முடிந்தது
வலி விடு
உறக்கத்தில் அமைதி
quote.kn:
ದಿನ ಮುಗಿದಿತು
ನೋವು ಬಿಡು
ನಿದ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಂತಿ
quote.ml:
ദിവസം അവസാനിച്ചു
വേദന വിടൂ
ഉറക്കത്തിൽ ശാന്തി
quote.en:
The day is done
Let go of pain
Find peace in sleep

quote.te:
చంద్రుడు చెబుతున్నాడు
నిశ్శబ్దం విను
మనసు సాంతం
quote.hi:
चाँद कहता है
खामोशी सुनो
दिल शांत होगा
quote.ta:
நிலா சொல்கிறது
அமைதியை கேள்
மனம் அமைதி
quote.kn:
ಚಂದ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ
ನಿಶ್ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳು
ಮನ ಶಾಂತ
quote.ml:
ചന്ദ്രൻ പറയുന്നു
നിശ്ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കൂ
മനം ശാന്തം
quote.en:
The moon whispers
Listen to silence
Your heart calms

quote.te:
ఈ రోజు చేసినంత చాలు
నీకు శాంతి ఇవ్వు
నిద్రలో నవ్వు
quote.hi:
आज जितना किया काफी
खुद को शांति दो
नींद में मुस्कान
quote.ta:
இன்று செய்தது போதும்
உனக்கு அமைதி கொடு
உறக்கத்தில் சிரி
quote.kn:
ಇಂದು ಮಾಡಿದಷ್ಟು ಸಾಕು
ನಿನಗೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ಕೊಡು
ನಿದ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಗು
quote.ml:
ഇന്ന് ചെയ്തതൊക്കെ മതിയാകട്ടെ
നിനക്ക് ശാന്തി
ഉറക്കത്തിൽ പുഞ്ചിരി
quote.en:
You did enough today
Give yourself peace
Smile in sleep

quote.te:
నక్షత్రాలు వెలిగుతున్నాయి
నీ కలలు కూడా వెలిగాలి
quote.hi:
तारे चमक रहे
तुम्हारे सपने भी चमकें
quote.en:
Stars are shining
Let your dreams shine too

quote.te:
నిశ్శబ్దం నిన్ను చుట్టుకుంది
మనసు మెల్లగా నిద్రపో
quote.hi:
खामोशी ने घेरा है
दिल धीरे सो जाए
quote.en:
Silence surrounds you
Let your heart drift to sleep

quote.hi:
थकान पिघल रही
सुकून पास आ रहा

Tiredness melts away
Peace comes closer

ఈ రాత్రి నీకు హత్తుకుంది
భయం దూరంగా పోయింది
quote.hi:
रात ने तुम्हें थामा
डर दूर चला गया
quote.en:
Night holds you close
Fear fades away

quote.te:
నీ కళ్ళు మూసుకో
మనసు తేలిక అవుతుంది
quote.hi:
आंखें बंद करो
दिल हल्का होगा
quote.en:
Close your eyes
Your heart feels lighter

quote.hi:
अंधेरा डर नहीं
यह आराम है
quote.en:
Darkness isn’t fear
It is rest

quote.te:
రేపు గురించి ఆలోచించకు
ఈ రాత్రి సేదతీరుకో
quote.hi:
कल की मत सोचो
आज आराम करो
quote.en:
Don’t think of tomorrow
Rest tonight

quote.te:
రోజు నీతో మాట్లాడింది
ఇప్పుడు నిశ్శబ్దం విను
quote.hi:
दिन ने बात की
अब खामोशी सुनो
quote.en:
The day has spoken
Now hear the silence

quote.te:
చిన్న క్షణాలు గుర్తు చేసుకో
మనసు నిండిపోతుంది
quote.hi:
छोटे पल याद करो
दिल भर जाएगा
quote.en:
Recall small moments
Your heart fills up

quote.te:
నీ హృదయం విశ్రాంతి కోరుతుంది
దానికి అవును చెప్పు
quote.hi:
दिल आराम चाहता
उसे हाँ कहो
quote.en:
Your heart asks for rest
Say yes to it

quote.te:
నక్షత్రాలు నీకు తోడుగా
రాత్రి మృదువుగా ఉంది
quote.hi:
तारे साथ हैं
रात कोमल है
quote.en:
Stars are with you
The night is gentle

quote.te:
నిశ్శబ్దం నీకు దుప్పటి
శాంతిగా కళ్ళు మూసుకో
quote.hi:
खामोशी चादर है
आंखें बंद करो
quote.en:
Silence is your blanket
Close your eyes in peace

quote.hi:
अंधेरा संभालेगा
नींद में सुकून
quote.en:
Darkness protects you
Sleep in calm

quote.te:
నీ ఆలోచనలు మెల్లగా ఆగాలి
మనసు విశ్రాంతి పొందాలి
quote.hi:
सोच धीमी हो जाए
दिल आराम पाए
quote.en:
Let thoughts slow down
Let your heart rest

quote.te:
ఈ రోజు ముగిసింది
నీకు ధన్యవాదాలు చెప్పు
quote.hi:
दिन खत्म हुआ
खुद को धन्यवाद दो
quote.en:
The day is over
Thank yourself

quote.te:
రేపు ఇంకా ఉంది
ఈ రాత్రి విశ్రాంతి తీసుకో
quote.hi:
कल अभी बाकी है
आज आराम करो
quote.en:
Tomorrow is waiting
Rest tonight

నీ గుండె శాంతి కోరుతుంది
దానికి సమయం ఇవ్వు
quote.hi:
दिल शांति चाहता
उसे समय दो
quote.ta:
இதயம் அமைதி கேட்கும்
அதை நேரம் கொடு
quote.kn:
ಹೃದಯ ಶಾಂತಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ
ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಯ ಕೊಡು
quote.en:
Your heart needs peace
Give it time

quote.hi:
थकान छोड़ दो
नींद में बहो
quote.en:
Let tiredness go
Drift into sleep

quote.hi:
खामोशी बोलती है
दिल सुन ले
quote.en:
Silence is speaking
Let your heart hear

quote.te:
నీ కలలు నిన్ను పిలుస్తున్నాయి
నిద్రలో వాటిని చేరుకో
quote.hi:
सपने बुला रहे
नींद में मिलो
quote.en:
Dreams are calling
Meet them in sleep

quote.te:
నీ శ్వాస నెమ్మదిగా ఉంది
రాత్రి నిన్ను హత్తుకుంది
quote.hi:
सांस धीमी है
रात ने थामा
quote.en:
Your breath is slow
Night holds you

quote.te:
నువ్వు దగ్గరగా ఉంటే
ప్రపంచం చిన్నగా అనిపిస్తుంది
quote.hi:
तुम पास होते हो
दुनिया छोटी लगती है
quote.en:
When you are near
The world feels small

quote.te:
నీ నవ్వు చూసినప్పుడే
నా రోజు పూర్తి అవుతుంది
quote.hi:
तुम्हारी मुस्कान से
मेरा दिन पूरा होता है
quote.en:
Your smile alone
Completes my day

quote.hi:
तुमसे बात करूं तो
दिल हल्का हो जाता है
quote.en:
Talking to you
Makes my heart lighter

quote.te:
నువ్వు ఉన్న చోటే
నా హృదయం ఉంటుంది
quote.hi:
जहां तुम हो
वहीं मेरा दिल है
quote.en:
Where you are
My heart lives there

quote.hi:
तुम्हारी बातों में
मेरा सुकून है
quote.en:
In your words
I find my peace

quote.te:
నిన్ను చూసిన ప్రతిసారి
కొత్తగా ప్రేమలో పడతాను
quote.hi:
हर बार तुम्हें देखकर
फिर से प्यार होता है
quote.en:
Every time I see you
I fall in love again

quote.hi:
तुम्हारा नाम सुनते ही
मुस्कान आ जाती है
quote.en:
Hearing your name
Brings me a smile

quote.hi:
तुम बिना
दिन खाली लगता है
quote.en:
Without you
The day feels empty

quote.te:
నీ కళ్ళలో చూసి
నా ప్రపంచం కనుగొన్నాను
quote.hi:
तेरी आंखों में
मैंने दुनिया पाई
quote.en:
In your eyes
I found my world

quote.hi:
तुम्हारे साथ
समय रुक जाता है
quote.en:
With you
Time stands still

quote.hi:
तुम संग चलूं तो
दिल को सुकून
quote.en:
Walking with you
My heart feels calm

quote.hi:
